subject.title: San Diego Community College District Board, District C

text: Primary election winner with 74% of the vote!

Due to my extensive classroom teaching experience, I know firsthand what it takes for students to succeed! I served for 26 years on the faculty of Grossmont College where I was awarded the Distinguished Faculty of the Year!

I want to ensure community colleges remain affordable, providing college transfer and career training opportunities, especially for our veterans. I supported recently passed legislation to make community college tuition free for all first-time students!

As a City of San Diego taxpayer, I want to ensure our tax dollars are spent wisely, with transparency and accountability. I currently serve on the San Diego District Budget Sub-Committee where I have ensured the San Diego Community College District’s budget remains aligned to best serve our students.

My qualifications include a master’s degree in Botany, and a bachelor’s degree in Biological Science. I have served on three college accreditation teams, as Co-Chair of my department, and an officer of the college’s Academic Senate.

A central mission of the San Diego Community College District is to provide transfer opportunities to four-year colleges. I have established grant partnerships with San Diego State University, the University of San Diego, and the University of California at San Diego to help our community college students successfully transfer.
I serve the board’s Housing subcommittee and the San Diego Regional Housing Authority addressing the impact of the affordable housing crisis for students, employees, and the community.

I am committed to green energy and high energy efficiency on all our campuses. I ride my bike for transportation whenever possible, drive an all-electric vehicle, and have installed solar panels on my home in North Park.

I am a strong advocate for and financially contribute to programs to eliminate student food insecurity. As the first openly gay board member I have worked to improve the services to the District’s LGBTQ+ students.

I am not a politician seeking higher office. I am a career teacher seeking to ensure our students receive the college transfer preparation and workforce training needed to be successful members of our community.
I am endorsed by the American Federation of Teachers, Mayor Todd Gloria, Assemblymember Chris Ward, and all current Governing Board Members of the San Diego Community College District!
I respectfully ask for your vote to the San Diego Community College District Governing Board.

statement.disclaimer: The statements are the opinions of the authors and have not been checked for accuracy by any official agency.
